speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) as of December 2017, what is the number of residents placed under the Silver Support Scheme (SSS); and (b) what is the number of SSS recipients who are also receiving financial aid from the Social Services Offices.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The scheme is targeted at seniors who had low incomes through life and who currently have relatively little or no family support.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: It complements the comprehensive range of Government schemes that help seniors with various needs, such as housing, healthcare and retirement.

speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
text: Some SSS recipients who are also Social Services Office (SSO) recipients shared with me that their financial aid from SSO was reduced by a corresponding monthly amount equal to their SSS payout.

speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
text: So, I would just like to ask the Second Minister, do the officers of SSS and SSO work together to determine the final quantum of financial aid paid out to these selected recipients?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: It really depends on what kind of support they are getting from the SSO.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: So, it really depends on the individual circumstances.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The best way, if Mr Png has encountered specific residents with such a question, is that they can refer the question to the SSO, who would be quite happy to explain to the ComCare recipient the circumstances that are unique to him and how the payouts are determined.
